## Welcome

`inspect-toolkit` is a collection of reusable building blocks for
[Inspect AI](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/) evaluations: metrics, scorers, solvers, tools, dataset
sources, and sandbox helpers that are useful to anyone using Inspect, independent of any particular
config system or agent framework.

It was extracted from the
[refactor-arena](https://github.com/fastfedora/refactor-arena) evaluation setting so its generic
pieces can be shared. It depends only on `inspect-ai`, `numpy`, and `pyyaml`, plus `gitpython` (used
only by the sandbox git-diff helpers vendored from Control Arena).

## Install

```bash
uv add inspect-toolkit        # or: pip install inspect-toolkit
```

Requires Python 3.12+.

## Quick Start

Everything here is a plain Inspect component. Pass the metrics to any `@scorer`, drop the scorers and
solvers into a `Task`, and hand the tools to an agent:

```python
from inspect_ai.scorer import mean, scorer, stderr
from inspect_toolkit.metrics import percentile, threshold_accuracy
from inspect_toolkit.scorers import test_runner_scorer

@scorer(metrics=[mean(), stderr(), percentile(target=95), threshold_accuracy(threshold=80)])
def my_scorer():
    ...

tests = test_runner_scorer("percent-pass")   # run the repo's test suite in the sandbox
```

## Learning More

Start with the components you need:

- [Metrics](guide/metrics.qmd): Distribution, threshold, safety and usefulness metrics, plus metrics
  attached dynamically at runtime.
- [Scorers](guide/scorers.qmd): Composite scoring, test running, file-contents search, and
  sandbox-state checks.
- [Solvers](guide/solvers.qmd): Setup repos, run tests and snapshot repos, plus diffs, exports and imports.
- [Tools](guide/tools.qmd): Deferred agent tools and a tool that lets an agent score itself
  mid-trajectory.
- [Dataset Sources](guide/datasets.qmd): Pluggable dataset sources with GitHub sparse-checkout
  caching.
- [Fixtures](guide/fixtures.qmd): Build Docker sandbox specifications from templates with feature
  flags and secret injection.
- [Database Diffing](guide/databases.qmd): Pure-stdlib SQLite diffing and a selector language for
  asserting on diffs.
- [Sandbox & Filesystem](guide/sandbox.qmd): Within-sandbox operations and repo-location
  resolution.
- [Coding Helpers](guide/coding.qmd): Repository setup and test running based on the repo language.
- [Message Helpers](guide/messages.qmd): Generic `inspect_ai` message transforms for monitor
  prompts.

For the complete API, see the [Reference](reference/index.qmd).
